mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, title, image_url, link_type, link_value, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_banner WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY sort_order DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_banner (tenant_id, title, image_url, link_type, link_value, sort_order, status, start_time, end_time, remark) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkType}, #{linkValue}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_banner SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, title = #{title}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, link_type = #{linkType}, link_value = #{linkValue}, sort_order = #{sort}, status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
